verdict.rationale: QBO documents strong reconciliation infrastructure (auto-import, auto-matching, reconciliation and discrepancy reports) and offers an official MCP server with 145 tools and full CRUD across entities/reports, plus an 'Intuit Intelligence' chat that can 'help resolve anomalies' — together these are plausible building blocks for an agent to drive reconciliation. However, there is no documented end-to-end agentic workflow that matches transactions, flags exceptions, and stages the books for human review as a single close process; the reconciliation features described are UI/human-driven, not agent-orchestrated. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or case study of an AI agent performing full month-end close via MCP, evidence of an 'exceptions queue' or close-review staging step, and independent confirmation the MCP/Intuit Intelligence tools actually accomplish this end-to-end.
